blocks.tamil_translation: they said. I went with them, and we passed by a man. He was lying down, and another man was standing beside him carrying a large rock in his hand. He hurled that rock forcefully onto the head of the one lying down, and his head was smashed to pieces. The rock fell to one side. By the time that man went and fetched the rock, the shattered head had become whole again. Then he threw the rock in the same way, and what happened before happened again. In amazement I asked the two angels, "Subhanallah! Who are these two?" (What is going on here?) They said, "Go on ahead." We went on and passed by a man lying on his back. Beside him a man stood holding an iron hook. He came to one side of the face of the man lying down and (thrusting the hook in his hand into one cheek of the man, tore it through to the back of his neck; pushing it into one nostril, tore it through to the back of his neck; and pushing it into one eye, tore it through to the back of his neck. It ripped through everything. Then he came to the other side and did the same. By then the first side had become completely sound again, and he kept on doing this. When I asked the two of them, "Subhanallah! Who are these two?" they said, "Go further on ahead." We went on and reached a fire pit. There was nothing but shouting and wailing in it. When we peeped in, there were a great many men and women in it, naked. When the blazing fire from beneath them engulfed them, they screamed.
